article_paragraphs: History books love romantic tales, like the one where Lee Iacocca, father of the Mustang, was responsible for giving birth to a whole new category of vehicles: pony cars. Sure, he was behind the creation of the most popular such vehicle, but the pony car concept was in the brewing stage years before the first-gen Mustang Mk1. While not strictly pony cars, these concepts and production sporty coupés already flirted with the concept of an enthusiast-grade compact car.

Of course, we don't mean to diminish Iacocca's genius. Yes, he didn't invent the wheel, but he definitely read the room better than his counterparts. In fact, some of the cars featured in this piece influenced him to create the special team of engineers that worked on the Mustang. From early Ford-based compact sports cars like the Budd XT-Bird Concept and Ford Falcon Futura Sport to rear-engine fun machines like the Chevrolet Corvair Monza Turbo, these pre-Mustang models warmed the public to the pony car idea.

Iacocca wasn't the first to toy with the idea of a compact sports car for the masses. Edward Gowan Budd, one of the early 20th century's most important engineers and entrepreneurs, already had dabbled with the idea of a 2+2 sports car for the masses. Better yet, he pitched a working prototype of the XT-Bird directly to Iacocca, likely planting the pony-car seed in his mind.

The proposed car was based on a 1961 Ford Falcon unibody and a modified body shell from a 1955 to 1957 Ford Thunderbird. This let Budd's company, Budd-American Motors, stretch the Thunderbird's 102-inch wheelbase by 7.5 inches, turning it from a two-seater into a 2+2. Yes, the rear seats were tight and mostly unusable, but the 2+2 configuration became a hallmark of pony cars, allowing buyers to take their friends and family on a joyride.

Speaking of which, the XT-Bird Concept was equipped with a 170-cubic-inch (2.8-liter) inline-6 engine. Yes, it's not a V8, but Budd boosted it with a supercharger, so it should've been potent enough for the time. Power figures were never disclosed, but we know the XT-Bird Concept had a three-speed manual.

While the XT-Bird Concept influenced Ford in developing the Mustang, its clumsy attempt to modernize the classic Thunderbird fell flat. Budd smoothed out the Thunderbird's rear fins and accentuated headlight housings, resulting in a bland, somewhat forgettable design.

Ford never accepted Budd's XT-Bird proposal, but that didn't stop the ambitious engineer from making another attempt at an early pony car. Unveiled mere months later, the XR-400 Concept was another fully functional, production-ready sporty convertible.

This time, though, Budd used a Rambler Ambassador chassis and proposed the idea to American Motors Corporation. He went so far to create a full development plan, estimating a low $4.1 million to bring the car to market. Because the XR-400 Concept utilized an existing AMC platform, tooling and production would've also been cheaper than building the car from the ground up. Had AMC greenlit the XR-400, it would've beaten both the Barracuda and the Mustang to showroom floors, completely rewriting pony car history. Heck, it might even have saved AMC from the Chrysler buyout. Instead, AMC surrendered its head start and played catch-up with the other old-school pony cars using the 1968 Javelin.

article_paragraphs: I had the pleasure of experiencing Buc-ee's Beaver Nuggets for the first time on a recent road trip. It's an experience I'll get to repeat soon as the popular chain of ginormous gas stations and convenience stores expands into my adopted home state of Arkansas, among other places . It'll be interesting to see if the midterm election results affect those expansion plans, as Buc-ee's president and co-founder Arch "Beaver" Aplin III has expressed a desire to avoid blue states, according to Fox Business .
At the grand opening of a new location in Benton, Arkansas, Aplin said:

"I'm starting to realize life's too short to try to build in places that people don't appreciate what you're bringing, versus a place like this where people do appreciate what you are building," he said.
Conservative states typically promote business-friendly and family-oriented policies that align with Buc-ee's values, Aplin said.

"That leadership, that concept, that idea of conservative, business-friendly, family-oriented concept works so much better if it trickles down from the very leadership from the top at the governor's office, at the congressman, at senator, at the mayor, the representatives," he said.

The thing is, Aplin no longer has that choice. The blue tsunami of the midterm election has turned several states formerly controlled by Republicans over to the Democrats at many of those levels, and in some cases all of them.

The most notable upset from the election is right in Buc-ee's home state of Texas. President Trump hand-picked the scandal-ridden Ken Paxton to run against Democratic contender James Talarico for U.S. Senate, pushing out incumbent Republican John Cornyn during the primaries (maybe he won't be able to steal the Space Shuttle after all). Elon Musk invested more than $200 million backing Paxton's election campaign. Despite all that, Talarico won, making him the first Democratic Senator from Texas since 1993. Ted Cruz remains in the Senate, but possibly only because he wasn't up for re-election this year.

It's not just the Senate, either. Governor Greg Abbott lost re-election to Democrat Gina Hinojosa, and the Texas House gained a slight Democratic majority as well. Buc-ee's now finds itself deeply entrenched and headquartered in a blue state, as unlikely as it was for Texas to flip like this. If Buc-ee's really doesn't want to do business in blue states, it's going to have to find a new home. So will Elon Musk , for that matter, just five years after fleeing California for the same reason.

article_paragraphs: Two-wheeler retail sales in India witnessed a significant year-on-year (YoY) decline in October 2026, with total registrations falling to 23,21,419 units. According to data released by the Federation of Automobile Dealers Associations (FADA), the overall automotive retail market also registered a sharp decline, primarily due to a shift in the festive calendar.

While Navratri fell in October this year, Dhanteras and Diwali celebrations have moved to November, impacting vehicle purchases during the month. Despite this sharp YoY decline, FADA noted that October 2026 was the second-best October on record for two-wheeler retail sales.

Petrol/ethanol-powered two-wheelers continued to dominate the Indian market, accounting for 90.30% of total retail sales in October 2026. Electric two-wheelers contributed a 9.65% share, while CNG/LPG-powered models accounted for the remaining 0.05%.

Demand trends indicated stronger sales momentum in urban markets as compared to that seen in rural areas. Rural demand was impacted due to deficient rainfall, coupled with a weak Kharif crop which had an adverse effect on consumer sentiment and purchasing activity.

Total two-wheeler retail sales stood at 23,21,419 units in October 2026, down 28.35% from 32,39,949 units registered in October 2025. However, on a month-on-month (MoM) basis, sales improved by 29.67% compared to 17,90,188 units recorded in September 2026 .

On a year-to-date (YTD) basis, covering April to October 2026, two-wheeler retail sales reached 1,33,79,362 units. This represented a 7.81% increase over the 1,24,09,794 units registered during the corresponding period last year.

Honda once again commanded the sales list with 6,37,630 unit sales with a strong 27.47% market share. Hero MotoCorp sales declined sharply on a YoY basis to 5,98,433 units from 10,06,796 units of Oct 2025 bringing down its market share to 25.78%.

TVS Motor sales also dipped to 4,58,303 units YoY though market share improved to 19.74%. Combined sales of Honda, Hero and TVS, which stood at 16,94,366 units, accounted for more than 72% of two-wheeler retail market during the month of October 2026.

title: Iridium Vs. Platinum Spark Plugs: Are There Performance Or Efficiency Differences?

But there are two main types of spark plugs on offer today: iridium and platinum, and the choice of spark plug can make a difference on how your car engine performs. summary: If you know anything about internal combustion, you'll know that spark plugs are key to performance and efficiency. But there are two main types of spark plugs on offer today: iridium and platinum, and the choice of spark plug can make a difference on how your car engine performs.
article_paragraphs: If you know anything about internal combustion, you'll know that spark plugs are key to performance and efficiency. But there are two main types of spark plugs on offer today: iridium and platinum, and the choice of spark plug can make a difference on how your car engine performs. That said, it's more nuanced than simply choosing one over the other, and it greatly depends on the application. First, the basics. Spark plugs in a gasoline engine play a key role because, without them, the gas-air mixture would not combust, and simply put, you'd go nowhere.

But even though they're a cornerstone of any gas engine — virtually as old as the invention itself — the tech behind them continues to develop. In the old days, spark plugs were made of copper. Copper is no longer used on modern cars because it wears out relatively quickly inside a cylinder of exploding gas that can routinely exceed 2,000 degrees Fahrenheit in normal operation. So, which type of spark plug is better? To answer that, we need to discuss which is most cost-effective for your situation and whether can you mix and match the two.

Whether or not you go for platinum or iridium spark plugs is highly dependent on your car and its engine. With a melting point of over 3,200 degrees Fahrenheit, platinum is perfect for most daily driving applications. It's tough, durable, and cost-effective, with platinum spark plugs capable of lasting beyond 60,000 miles in a well-maintained engine. Iridium plugs, on the other hand, are your high-performance heroes.

If you've got a powerful vehicle with a high-performance engine — one that's turbocharged and/or high-revving — it almost definitely needs iridium plugs. In fact, many modern engines come from the factory with iridium spark plugs in a quest for more efficiency and durability. Iridium spark plugs have a melting point of around 4,400 degrees Fahrenheit, meaning they can handle the increased temperatures of highly-strung gasoline powerplants. Plus, they come with ultra-fine electrodes that generate a more precise and cleaner spark.

This has a double benefit; in addition to optimal power, it also provides better fuel efficiency. So, what is the main disadvantage of iridium spark plugs? Iridium spark plugs can be expensive compared to their platinum counterparts — although probably not as pricey as quoted by one Dodge dealership. In fact, they can cost over twice as much as an equivalent platinum spark plug. But, if you've got a performance car that requires this type of spark plug, then yes, they are worth the extra money.

Now that you know about platinum and iridium spark plugs, you should have a better idea about how they affect your car's performance and efficiency. But when it comes to mixing the two, it's a pretty hard no. You shouldn't do this under any circumstances. Using a mix of iridium and platinum plugs in your engine will cause myriad issues, since combustion won't be well-matched across all cylinders. If you're replacing the spark plugs, you need to replace all of them with the correct type, at the same time.

As well, you won't get a performance boost if you install iridium plugs in an engine designed for platinum plugs, even when it's a $20,000 job on a Bugatti. You'll only be draining your wallet unnecessarily. By the same token, if you think you can install platinum plugs in an engine designed for iridium, you shouldn't do this either, as there will be issues with performance and fuel efficiency. At the end of the day, the best advice we can give you is to consult what the manufacturer has specified and stick to that, whether that be platinum or iridium spark plugs.

raw_summary: Yamaha is expanding its electric scooter lineup with the new XENTER E, a 125cc-equivalent electric scooter designed specifically with European city riding in mind. Unveiled around EICMA 2026 in Milan alongside the new NMAX E , the XENTER E is a high-wheel scooter riding on 16-inch wheels front and rear.
summary: Yamaha is expanding its electric scooter lineup with the new XENTER E, a 125cc-equivalent electric scooter designed specifically with European city riding in mind. Unveiled around EICMA 2026 in Milan alongside the new NMAX E , the XENTER E is a high-wheel scooter riding on 16-inch wheels front and rear.
article_paragraphs: Yamaha is expanding its electric scooter lineup with the new XENTER E, a 125cc-equivalent electric scooter designed specifically with European city riding in mind.
Unveiled around EICMA 2026 in Milan alongside the new NMAX E , the XENTER E is a high-wheel scooter riding on 16-inch wheels front and rear.

That’s an important distinction in European cities, where larger wheels can make quick work of the cobblestones, potholes, and tram tracks that can turn smaller-wheeled scooters into teeth-rattling experiences.

The XENTER E uses Yamaha’s new eAxle powertrain, combining the motor, controller, and reduction gearbox into a compact frame-mounted unit. The motor produces 7.5 kW (10 hp) of peak power and 33.3 Nm of torque, putting the scooter into Europe’s A1 license category.

Mounting the motor to the frame also means Yamaha can use a more conventional motorcycle-style swingarm rather than hanging the motor on the rear suspension like many scooters. That reduces unsprung weight and should help improve handling and ride quality.

Power is supplied from an integrated 3.5 kWh battery mounted low in the chassis. Yamaha claims 108 km (67 miles) of range on the WMTC Class 1 cycle, though real-world range is expected to be somewhat lower.
An 800W onboard charger can refill the battery in around 5.5 hours from a public charging station. Yamaha will also offer a cable for charging from a household outlet.

Other niceties include three riding modes, traction control, regenerative braking, a reverse mode for maneuvering at low speeds, smart-key operation, and a 5-inch TFT display. Smartphone connectivity adds navigation, battery information, maintenance reminders, and parking-location tracking.

Fabio Di Giannantonio, the Friday pace-setter, will join the pair on the front row, while the second row will feature Trackhouse Aprilia duo Raul Fernandez and Ai Ogura - and Marquez's team-mate Pecco Bagnaia between them.

Johann Zarco was Honda's sole representative in Q2 and took an encouraging seventh, ahead of Pedro Acosta. Acosta earned the ire of Jorge Martin, who felt Acosta didn't do a good enough job getting out of the way late on.

Acosta's streak of 61 consecutive qualifying victories over his team-mates had been in danger after Friday - but was rescued and extended to 62 as he navigated Q1 and his team-mate Brad Binder compromised his session by crashing at Turn 1 on his first push lap.
Fermin Aldeguer, Enea Bastianini and Martin slotted in between Acosta and Binder.

title: The Ford Maverick Has Some Clever Hidden Features Most People Don't Know About

Bush-era revisions to the Corporate Average Fuel Economy (CAFE) standards, which linked each truck's fuel-economy target to its footprint, holding bigger trucks to lower mpg targets.

While some automakers have abandoned the compact and midsize truck segments, the ones still going strong are pretty impressive. In particular, the Ford Maverick is nearly the perfect truck , even with its un-trucklike unibody design. And if its excellent hybrid fuel efficiency, spiffy handling, user-friendly tech, and agreeable ride don't sell it for you, then maybe some of its hidden features will.

You see, the 2027 Ford Maverick isn't exactly a what-you-see-is-what-you-get truck. The Maverick comes with standard and optional features that don't announce themselves with much fanfare but are highly useful when you know where to look and how to take advantage of them. Knowing how to access and use extra storage, onboard power, and a plethora of customizable safety features will take your Maverick ownership to the next level.

Yes, most pickups are designed for hauling, so lots of storage is to be expected. That's what the whole bed is for, even if the average truck owner doesn't actually use it for truck stuff. The Maverick goes above and beyond, though, in offering flexible and functional options, plus plentiful hidden storage. This should partially make up for the fact that its 54.4-inch bed is about a foot shorter than the smallest bed on an F-150.

When futzing with storage options in the bed, you'll find that the Maverick uses Ford's Flexbed design. This includes a multi-position tailgate and fixed tie-down points, two of which — found on the gate — double as bottle openers for when you're having a tailgate party or need a crisp pre-drive Topo Chico. A cargo management system with bed rails and a small cubby recessed into the body of the truck is also available, with a removable tray to unlock more space. There's even a QR code in the bed that links to ideas for exploring bed storage techniques. You can also option in-bed LED box lighting to keep the area illuminated while you're working in low light. Additionally, the bed has a grooved design intended to make it easy to build and install your own storage solutions using 2x4s or 2x6s.

In the cab itself, you'll find storage under the rear bench. It's big enough for a small backpack, camera gear, work boots, or whatever tickles your fancy. Door storage gives enough room for decently sized water bottles, and there's additional storage space behind the 13.2-inch infotainment screen. Of course, you'll find storage in the center console armrest, too.

It's not exactly a secret that you can option even the base XL trim with Co-Pilot360, a suite of safety and driver-assistance features. However, using the system to its fullest potential takes a little massaging, and you'll likely want to customize the system to your preferences for the best possible experience. After all, aren't customizability and adaptability the true meaning of truck ownership ?

Depending on the trim and options, a Maverick's version of Co-Pilot360 can include pre-collision assist with automatic emergency braking, a rearview camera, blind-spot monitoring with cross-traffic alert, lane-keep assist, automatic high-beam headlights, stop-and-go adaptive cruise control with lane centering, evasive steering assist, and post-collision braking. Co-Pilot360 technology also covers towing aids like Pro Trailer Hitch Assist. However, not every driver will want to have all of these features active all the time, and knowing how to turn certain features on or off piecemeal will lead to a better experience overall.

summary: Honda makes just about everything with a motor, from lawnmowers and generators to cars, motorcycles, and even airplanes. Now the Japanese giant is adding another electrified vehicle to the list – a premium electric mountain bike. Unveiled at EICMA 2026 in Milan, the new Honda RN0 marks the company’s first entry into the premium electric mountain bike market.
article_paragraphs: Honda makes just about everything with a motor, from lawnmowers and generators to cars, motorcycles, and even airplanes. Now the Japanese giant is adding another electrified vehicle to the list – a premium electric mountain bike.

Unveiled at EICMA 2026 in Milan, the new Honda RN0 marks the company’s first entry into the premium electric mountain bike market. And unlike many automotive-branded e-bikes that amount to little more than a licensing deal and a familiar logo slapped on someone else’s frame, Honda appears to have actually put some engineering muscle behind this one.

The RN0 was jointly developed with German high-end e-MTB manufacturer ROTWILD and features a proprietary carbon monocoque frame and distinctive gull-arm swingarm inspired by Honda’s motorcycle chassis development experience.

There’s actually some real history behind that connection. Honda experimented with mountain bike development in the early 2000s, culminating in its wild RN01 downhill racing bike. In 2005, that project won the overall series championship in the UCI Mountain Bike Downhill World Cup. Honda never turned the RN01 into a consumer bicycle, but more than two decades later, the RN0 is effectively picking up where the company previously left off.

The roughly 24 kg (53 lb) RN0 is set up as a multi-role electric mountain bike, featuring 160 mm FOX 36 FLOAT Factory Kashima front suspension paired with a FOX FLOAT X Factory Kashima rear shock. DT Swiss H1900 SPLINE wheels use a mullet setup with a 29-inch wheel up front and 27.5-inch wheel in the rear, while Shimano DEORE XT four-piston brakes handle stopping duties.
Those are some quality components, but the drivetrain may be even more interesting.
Honda is using Shimano’s new 2.3 kg drive unit, rated for up to 100 Nm of torque and 750 watts of maximum output, paired with a sizeable 720 Wh battery.
Shimano’s AUTO ASSIST can automatically vary motor assistance based on terrain and rider input, while AUTO SHIFT handles gear changes to maintain an appropriate cadence.

title: Gary Anderson's verdict on McLaren's 2027-leaning upgrade
raw_summary: No team wants to show its dirty washing in public, so McLaren calling its new front wing effectively a 2027 concept seems strange. In that position, assuming the numbers on track and the simulation tools show it has potential, I’d be using it now and considering it very much a 2026 part. With (perhaps) four races remaining and roughly five months before the start of next season, I’d be learning as much as possible from it and would hopefully make a step or two as a result of it before next season kicks off.
summary: No team wants to show its dirty washing in public, so McLaren calling its new front wing effectively a 2027 concept seems strange. In that position, assuming the numbers on track and the simulation tools show it has potential, I’d be using it now and considering it very much a 2026 part.
article_paragraphs: No team wants to show its dirty washing in public, so McLaren calling its new front wing effectively a 2027 concept seems strange.

In that position, assuming the numbers on track and the simulation tools show it has potential, I’d be using it now and considering it very much a 2026 part. With (perhaps) four races remaining and roughly five months before the start of next season, I’d be learning as much as possible from it and would hopefully make a step or two as a result of it before next season kicks off.
The intersection between the mainplane and the lower foot of the endplate, highlighted with the red ellipse, is what caught my eye.

Red Bull started the season with this concept, and Mercedes and others have followed. Making it more of a single lower surface reduces the sensitivity of the endplate footplate to the track, so in high-speed corners the front of the car should produce more consistent downforce. Basically, it should feel less snatchy, making the rear of the car more stable.
The slot gap profile between the forward and central elements, highlighted with the green arrow, has also been altered.

This is in line with the profile change highlighted with the light blue arrow and the positioning of the longest chord section of the third element. With that section slightly more inboard, this will alter where the mass flow reaches the leading edge of the floor.

What confuses me a little is the change from reducing the angle of the second and third elements in straight mode to reducing only the angle of the third when straight mode is activated. It means that the front wing is less powerful in corner mode, but that comes at the expense of overall downforce.

When the wing is in cornering mode (max downforce), the low pressure on the lower surface will pull more of its airflow through the slot gap between the first and second elements. To compensate for this, McLaren has reduced the chord length of the mainplane, highlighted with the green arrow, and increased the chord length of the second element, highlighted with the light blue arrow.

raw_title: Diesel Pickups Get Better MPGs Than Gas, But Is It Enough To Counteract Diesel Prices?
title: Diesel Pickups Get Better MPGs Than Gas, But Is It Enough To Counteract Diesel Prices?
raw_summary: For this piece, we're placing ourselves into the shoes of a pickup truck buyer who wants to get the best value-for-money deal possible from a new truck. Fuel prices remain near record highs, even after Trump's dirty Russian oil deal , so it's reasonable to expect buyers to make fuel costs a major deciding factor when looking at which truck to take home. In fact, as of this writing, the latest EIA figures see gas at $4.28 per gallon, while diesel sits at $6.27. On the face of it then, it would appear that gas is the way to go, but the math isn't that straightforward. Diesel trucks are more efficient per gallon, as a general rule, so that gallon will return more miles, in theory. If it returns sufficient additional miles, it then becomes the more cost-effective fuel, despite setting owners back more at the pump.

article_paragraphs: For this piece, we're placing ourselves into the shoes of a pickup truck buyer who wants to get the best value-for-money deal possible from a new truck. Fuel prices remain near record highs, even after Trump's dirty Russian oil deal , so it's reasonable to expect buyers to make fuel costs a major deciding factor when looking at which truck to take home.

In fact, as of this writing, the latest EIA figures see gas at $4.28 per gallon, while diesel sits at $6.27. On the face of it then, it would appear that gas is the way to go, but the math isn't that straightforward. Diesel trucks are more efficient per gallon, as a general rule, so that gallon will return more miles, in theory. If it returns sufficient additional miles, it then becomes the more cost-effective fuel, despite setting owners back more at the pump.

Now, heavy-duty trucks are exempt from standard EPA fuel economy testing, which makes picking between gas and diesel a little trickier. Thankfully, Car and Driver has been testing such trucks on a 200-mile fuel-efficiency highway route for the last 10 years, so we can use its data to determine whether diesel- or gas-powered trucks work out to be the more cost-effective choice.

As it happens, the outlet's 2024 roundup highlighted that diesel trucks on average return 18 mpg, while gas trucks net 15, so there's a 20% increase in fuel efficiency when running on diesel. Sounds great, but using the aforementioned figures, diesel is 46.5% more expensive, so a thirsty gas-guzzling truck is still kinder on the pocket.

Of course, those are only generalized figures taken from across all models tested. The outlet has run a total of 22 heavy-duty models on its 200-mile efficiency route. Of those, the top five most efficient models were all diesel-powered, and the top two managed to eke out 20 mpg. They are the 2018 Ram 2500 Limited Crew Cab, and the 2023 Ford F-250 Super Duty Platinum Tremor Crew Cab, powered respectively by standard-output Cummins and high-output Power Stroke engines.

Putting a Cummins against a Power Stroke engine highlights pros and cons for each camp, but regardless of which each individual favors, it's hard to argue with how impressive 20 mpg is, considering the size and heft of the trucks they each power. Still, that extra 2 mpg sadly doesn't make the difference when it comes to cost-per-mile, although it does help to close the gap significantly.

Using the above per-gallon prices, a 20-mpg diesel truck still costs around 10% more than a 15-mpg gas truck, costing $0.31 each mile, against the gas truck's $0.29. For the math to swing into the diesel truck's favor, it would have to be returning at least 22 mpg, at which point, it would cost almost exactly the same per mile as the gas truck.

We aren't about to suggest you start employing hypermiling techniques to get a few extra miles out of an old Cummins-powered Ram, like overinflating the tires, or stripping weight out by throwing air-conditioning units and back seats away. However, there are some useful tips you can follow to get better fuel economy .

raw_summary: GaadiWaadi - Maruti Suzuki to launch its first pure electric people mover in quick succession after the e Vitara, challenging the Kia Carens Clavis EV Not long after introducing the e Vitara, Maruti Suzuki has started development of its second electric car, which will be an MPV. The company is likely to unveil it at the biennial Auto Expo, set to be held in February 2027. During Maruti Suzuki’s Q2 FY2027 earnings conference call, Chief Investor Relations Officer Rahul Bharti revealed that the company plans to launch its next EV at Bharat Mobility Global Expo 2027. In all likelihood, he was referring to the aforementioned electric MPV Codenamed ‘Maruti YMC’, the electric MPV is being tested on public roads since summer this year. Recently, Instagram user carlord_767 spotted one of the several prototypes of the Maruti YMC undergoing tests on the road. A spy video shared by the spotter has shown several details of the model’s exterior. At the rear, we can see the Maruti YMC featuring Maruti Ertiga-like vertical LED tail lights. The tail lights are connected via a horizontal strip, although we doubt it is illuminated. An LED high-mounted stop lamp and a shark-fin antenna can also be seen. Also Read: Huge Diwali Discounts On Maruti Suzuki Arena Cars; Up To Rs. 1.21 Lakh Image Source: CarIndiaNews The side profile has a boxy appearance but leans more toward SUV than MPV. The beltline is set quite high, leading to a sleek look for the greenhouse. These attributes, as well as the angular, squared-off wheel arches, make the Maruti YMC reminiscent of the Maruti e Vitara from the sides. 18-inch alloy wheels will likely be part of the standard equipment. Previous sightings have indicated that the front end of the Maruti YMC will likely also have hints of the Maruti e Vitara. Here, too, the car will look more SUV than an MPV. The bonnet should be set high and have a largely flattish design. The headlamps should be horizontal but have vertical extensions. The nose section is likely to be covered with a body-coloured surface. We expect two power-electric variants, both with a single motor powering the front wheels. The base variant’s motor should produce 105.8 kW (142 hp) and 193 Nm of torque, and the top variant’s motor will likely develop 128 kW (172 hp) and 193 Nm of torque. The former will likely draw power from a 48.8 kWh LFP battery pack, and the latter should draw power from a 61.1 kWh LFP unit. We expect the top variant to have a range of approximately 525 kilometres.

raw_title: Mahindra BE 7 Spied In BKC Mumbai – With GNSS Receiver On Roof
title: Mahindra BE 7 Spied In BKC Mumbai
raw_summary: Mahindra Auto has been testing and developing BE 7 for some time now and there have been multiple spy shots of it. Latest ones show BE 7 from close proximity and in much greater detail than before. Also, we can see some additional antenna equipment retrofitted on top of the roof which will probably not make it to production. These added antenna equipment look like they are high precision receivers for Global Navigation Satellite System (GNSS) and they help locate the vehicle accurately down to a centimeter. These latest spy shots of Mahindra BE 7 test mule with GNSS receiver were captured in BKC area of Mumbai, India.
summary: Mahindra Auto has been testing and developing BE 7 for some time now and there have been multiple spy shots of it. article_paragraphs: Mahindra Auto has been testing and developing BE 7 for some time now and there have been multiple spy shots of it. Latest ones show BE 7 from close proximity and in much greater detail than before. Also, we can see some additional antenna equipment retrofitted on top of the roof which will probably not make it to production.

These added antenna equipment look like they are high precision receivers for Global Navigation Satellite System (GNSS) and they help locate the vehicle accurately down to a centimeter. These latest spy shots of Mahindra BE 7 test mule with GNSS receiver were captured in BKC area of Mumbai, India.

There are two XEVs in the portfolio (XEV 9e, XEV 9S), but only one BE offering (BE 6), which will change soon with BE 7. The launch timeline is not known yet and 2027 could be the year. There have been multiple test mule sightings up until now and the latest spy shots show BE 7 test mules with GNSS receivers on top.

Currently, there are two fully operational GNSS systems – GPS from USA and GLONASS from Russia. There are other regional systems as well, including the recently operational India’s NavIC system. GNSS systems include constellations of satellites orbiting earth, broadcasting locations across space and time.

These broadcasted locations across ground control stations are crucial to calculate ground positions. GNSS systems are beneficial across a wide range of transportation from space travel and aviation to mass transportation too. Presence of these GNSS antennas on Mahindra BE 7 test mule could suggest multiple things including a next gen in-built navigation or even location-based ADAS features.

The latest spy shots of Mahindra BE 7 are snagged from BKC area in Mumbai, by Reddit user DemorganX. We can see full camouflage on this test mule and then Mahindra’s new flush door handles that are fully automated like in a Tesla or BYD. It will be India’s first mainstream vehicle to get frameless windows too, which buyers are likely to appreciate (I certainly would).

We can see the new clamshell bonnet along with large C-shaped lighting elements. Large wheels (presumably 19-inchers), angular wheel arch claddings and hidden rear washer and wiper are notable. Charging flap is on the rear left quarter panel, where one would usually see a fuel filler cap. BE 7 is a much larger vehicle and has a more SUV-like silhouette, when compared to BE 6.

On the inside, Mahindra BE 7 dashboard is expected to be closer to its concept form without a halo loop around driver. Centre console and sporty seats might be similar to that of BE 6’s. A triple screen dashboard can be seen in these spy shots too and other expected attributes are ventilated seats, 1400W 16 speaker Harman system, Adrenox suite, Level-2+ ADAS, powered seats, fancy ambient lighting, auto parking features and more.

title: Car Retail Sales Oct 2026 - Maruti, Tata, Mahindra, Hyundai, Kia, Toyota, Skoda VW, MG, Honda
raw_summary: India’s passenger vehicle retail sales stood at 5,07,768 units in October 2026, registering a 14.23% year-on-year (YoY) decline compared to 5,92,032 units sold in October 2025. However, sales recorded a strong month-on-month (MoM) growth of 18.86% over the 4,27,213 units retailed in September 2026 . This YoY decline can largely be attributed to a shift in the festive calendar, with key occasions such as Dhanteras and Diwali falling in November this year. Dhanteras will be celebrated on November 6, followed by Diwali on November 8, 2026, pushing a significant portion of festive vehicle purchases into the following month. However, despite the annual decline, October 2026 recorded the third-highest October retail sales in history, highlighting the underlying strength of this segment.

article_paragraphs: India’s passenger vehicle retail sales stood at 5,07,768 units in October 2026, registering a 14.23% year-on-year (YoY) decline compared to 5,92,032 units sold in October 2025. However, sales recorded a strong month-on-month (MoM) growth of 18.86% over the 4,27,213 units retailed in September 2026 .

This YoY decline can largely be attributed to a shift in the festive calendar, with key occasions such as Dhanteras and Diwali falling in November this year. Dhanteras will be celebrated on November 6, followed by Diwali on November 8, 2026, pushing a significant portion of festive vehicle purchases into the following month. However, despite the annual decline, October 2026 recorded the third-highest October retail sales in history, highlighting the underlying strength of this segment.

Cumulative retail sales for the period April-October 2026 period also remained encouraging. YTD sales increased by 16.14% to 30,68,353 units, up from 26,35,837 units retailed during the corresponding period last year.

In a fuel wise breakup, petrol/ethanol cars dominated with a 41.60% share while diesel held a 16.57% share and CNG/LPG commanded a 24.59% share. There was a significant rise in hybrid (strong + mild) and EVs which improved their market shares to 9.94% and 7.38% respectively. Urban and rural demand ended on a positive note with a 20.10% and 16.90% growth.

Maruti Suzuki continued to dominate the passenger vehicle retail market, registering sales of 2,11,996 units in October 2026 and commanding a market share of 41.75%. Tata Motors secured a No. 2 position with 73,449 units, overtaking Mahindra, which recorded sales of 64,982 units.

Tata Motors maintained an advantage of 8,467 units over Mahindra during the past month. However, both automakers strengthened their market positions, with market shares of 14.47% and 12.80%, respectively.

Hyundai Motor at No. 4 suffered a sales setback to 58,099 units in Oct 2026 from 69,458 units sold in Oct 2025 while Kia India overtook Toyota with 30,799 unit sales. Toyota sales dipped to 28,727 units from 38,367 units on a YoY basis taking down market share to 6%.

VW Skoda Group, which saw retail sales at 9,150 units in the past month, suffered a sequential decline in its market share to 1.80% from 2.27% held in the same month last year when sales had stood at 13,459 units.

raw_title: Mahindra Confirms 5 New Vehicle Launches In H1 2027 – Key Details
title: Mahindra Confirms 5 New Vehicle Launches In H1 2027
raw_summary: GaadiWaadi - The five launches comprise a NU_IQ model, an INGLO electric SUV, the Scorpio Lifestyler, a significant model revision and a new light commercial vehicle Mahindra has confirmed five new model launches for the first half of 2027 as the manufacturer prepares to introduce new SUVs and commercial vehicles. Rajesh Jejurikar, Executive Director and CEO of the Auto and Farm Sectors, outlined the plans at the Q2 FY27 media briefing. The schedule consists of the first production model on the NU_IQ architecture, an entirely new INGLO electric vehicle and the Scorpio Lifestyler pickup. A substantial revision to an existing vehicle and a new light commercial vehicle are also scheduled before the end of June 2027. The Scorpio Lifestyler is the only new passenger vehicle among these five whose production identity has been officially confirmed. Mahindra unveiled the pickup this past August and announced a launch by April 2027. Prices will start below Rs. 19.79 lakh (ex-showroom). Jejurikar also confirmed that the Lifestyler will be registered as a personal vehicle using a white number plate. Its upright front fascia, separate cargo bed and Scorpio styling distinguish it from the regular Scorpio N and it will be powered by a diesel mill. The first NU_IQ production vehicle could be derived from the Vision S concept unveiled in August 2025. Test vehicles believed to be based on the concept have been spotted repeatedly on Indian roads. The prototypes feature a boxy body, short overhangs, flush door handles and an externally mounted spare wheel. A panoramic sunroof has also been spotted and we expect the production Vision S to sit between XUV 3XO and Scorpio N. The NU_IQ monocoque architecture supports petrol, diesel, hybrid and electric powertrains. The second new vehicle will use the dedicated INGLO electric architecture. The BE 07 is a possible candidate as prototypes believed to belong to the model have already undergone road testing. Earlier images revealed a cabin featuring three dashboard screens and a large central console and it will design will be heavily influenced by the concept as well. The SUV could share the 59 kWh and 79 kWh battery options available on existing INGLO vehicles such as the BE 6. The significant model revision is another interesting part of the announcement as Mahindra already introduced updates for the Scorpio N and the Thar OG in 2026. The Thar Roxx is one possibility after recent test sightings indicated changes to the suspension and alloy wheels. However, Mahindra has not connected those prototypes to its 2027 product calendar. The fifth launch will be a new light commercial vehicle and the company recently introduced an updated Veero. Pic Source: Reddit – u/ParticularNext1196 Mahindra is also increasing production capacity at its Chakan manufacturing facility ahead of these introductions. Jejurikar confirmed that the company expects to establish approximately 8,000 units of additional monthly NU_IQ capacity by February or March 2027. Electric vehicle manufacturing capacity will rise by another 4,000 units per month to 12,000 units. The company has also acquired the initial parcel of land for its Nagpur manufacturing project and has begun execution work at the site. The new manufacturing investments come after Mahindra reported sales of around 1.83 lakh SUVs in the July to September 2026 quarter.

raw_title: BYD Yangwang U9 Xtreme Shatters 500 Kmph Top Speed Barrier – World’s First
title: BYD Yangwang U9 Xtreme Shatters 500 Kmph Top Speed Barrier - World's First
raw_summary: GaadiWaadi - The electric hypercar records 503.17 kmph on a closed Abu Dhabi highway securing FIA recognition and two Guinness World Records BYD had already established a 496.22 kmph speed record for the Yangwang U9 Xtreme in Germany in September 2025 but the electric hypercar has now crossed the 500 kmph barrier. Racing driver Marc Basseng clocked 503.17 kmph on a closed road in Abu Dhabi on November 1, 2026. The result made the U9 Xtreme the first production car to achieve the figure. The FIA recognised the run which surpassed the earlier attempt by 6.95 kmph. Guinness World Records certified two categories for the achievement: the highest one-way speed by a production car and the corresponding record for an electric production car. The measurement was independently verified using a calibrated VBOX system. An FIA official examined the data and confirmed the result. However, the attempt did not establish a two-way average which is required under other production car speed record protocols. The attempt took place on Sheikh Khalifa Bin Zayed International Road in the Al Dhafra region of Abu Dhabi. Local authorities closed a 10 km section of the E11 highway and a 7 km uninterrupted straight was available for the high speed runs. The road was swept before the attempts and engineers inspected the surface for small wire fragments left by road-sweeping brushes. Basseng had previously driven the same hypercar at Germany’s ATP Papenburg proving ground. The first two attempts on October 31 produced a maximum speed of 490 kmph. Engineers subsequently increased the rear wing angle to improve rear axle downforce, revised the suspension rebound calibration and adjusted tyre pressures. Battery and motor temperatures also received extra attention before the November 1 runs. The first attempt that day confirmed improvements in stability and tyre performance, and the second recorded the final 503.17 kmph figure. The U9 Xtreme uses four independent electric motors rated at 555 kW each. Their combined output stands at 3,019 PS. Each motor can operate at speeds of up to 30,000 rpm. The hypercar also uses a 1,200 V electrical architecture instead of the 800 V system found in the standard U9. Its lithium iron phosphate Blade Battery supports extremely high discharge rates while the e4 torque vectoring system adjusts power independently at each wheel more than 100 times per second. The active suspension is another essential component of the U9 Xtreme. Its DiSus-X system can generate up to 50 kN of vertical force in 120 milliseconds to control body movement. Giti developed specialised semi-slick tyres that use a dedicated compound and a treatment at the tyre rim interface to resist slippage under heavy acceleration or braking. Visually, the car features a low wedge-shaped nose, narrow lighting elements, a front splitter, an adjustable rear wing and a substantial rear diffuser. The U9 Xtreme has also completed the Nürburgring Nordschleife in 6 minutes 59.157 seconds. The car used the same technical specification as the record-breaking example. BYD plans to manufacture only 30 units worldwide. A production standard vehicle named Dawn Moment was displayed at the Beijing Auto Show earlier this year and some customers have already approved their individual specifications. The manufacturer is now progressing towards contract signing and production scheduling for those vehicles.

Even though the company has not made any public announcements, Volkswagen Tiguan R-Line has now been discontinued from India and is de-listed from the official website. An official statement for this development is not released yet, but buyers looking for a premium mid-size SUV from VW can still look into Tayron.

Tiguan R-Line’s last recorded price tag was Rs 47.11 lakh (Ex-sh) and the company has now de-listed it from their official website, hinting at a possible discontinuation from the Indian market. Sold alongside the Tiguan R-Line was the slightly larger and more practical Tayron R-Line offering flexibility of three-row seating.

In terms of prices, Tayron R-Line is priced at Rs 47.74 lakh (Ex-sh), which is around the same price tag as Tiguan-R Line. Also, making a stronger case for Tayron R-Line was the fact that it was a locally assembled model brought into the country via CKD route (Completely Knocked Down) and assembled at their facility in Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar.

Because Tayron is a locally assembled model, Volkswagen also offers it in multiple variants and one of those variants is called Tayron Life, which is a 5-seater version of the 7-seater Tayron with more space in second row and then a larger boot. This 5-seater Tayron Life was priced at Rs 41.99 lakh (Ex-sh).

With Volkswagen Tiguan R-Line discontinued, the brand’s SUV portfolio for the Indian market has come down to two models – Taigun and Tayron. Taigun is the more affordable mass-market offering while Tayron is for buyers with aspirations to own a larger and a more premium mid-size SUV with a dash of performance and a host of features and technology.

The same 2.0L Turbo Petrol engine as Tayron R-Line also powered the Tiguan R-Line. This engine developed 201 bhp of peak power and 320 Nm of peak torque, mated to a sole 7-speed DSG transmission. Volkswagen’s 4MOTION AWD system was standard with Tiguan R Line.

title: Is Trump About To Reignite His Big EV Push?
raw_summary: There are so many ironies with the Trump presidency. I remember writing about many of them in his first term. Now, though, we have some additional ones. For example, despite his apparent hate for clean technologies (wind power, solar power, electric vehicles, energy efficient appliances), Trump has pushed a ton of people to buy electric vehicles, including people who really wouldn’t consider doing so even with normal EV incentives in place. Of course, we all know what this is about. This was a key reason for the absolutely massive blue tsunami that took over the country this week. Trump’s war on Iran, which many Americans can’t explain in the slightest, drove gasoline prices up enormously and pushed people to go to the polls and vote Republican.

For example, despite his apparent hate for clean technologies (wind power, solar power, electric vehicles, energy efficient appliances), Trump has pushed a ton of people to buy electric vehicles, including people who really wouldn’t consider doing so even with normal EV incentives in place.

Of course, we all know what this is about. This was a key reason for the absolutely massive blue tsunami that took over the country this week. Trump’s war on Iran, which many Americans can’t explain in the slightest, drove gasoline prices up enormously and pushed people to go to the polls and vote Republican.

Trump and his team also knew this. They knew that the war on Iran was raising gas prices and that high gas prices are one of the worst things you can have when running for office. So, even though Trump didn’t leave himself any easy and simple way to get out of the war on Iran, he quieted down or paused his most significant actions against the country for the midterm elections and gas prices are not as high as they were a few months ago. They are just above $4/gallon on average , whereas the rose above $4.50/gallon earlier this year. Just in the week leading into election day, the national gas price average dropped by 12 cents a gallon . Of course, it was too little too late, and Republican politicians’ lack of concern for families and their high gas costs didn’t fare well in the election. This was probably the leading single factor for the swing to the left.

Now that the election is over and the war is not close to any resolution as far as we can tell, Trump may be inclined to heat it up again. If he has been holding back, he may go full force again into trying to force Iran to give in, and this could lead to a bigger closure of the Strait of Hormuz … which would likely lead to spiking gas prices again. Naturally, even at $4/gallon, Trump is making a lot of Americans ( and humans more broadly ) think about buying electric vehicles, and some of them are going to go ahead and making the switch. What if Trump goes further, as many now expect he will, and oil supply is disrupted much worse and oil prices spike again? He could become one of the greatest EV salesmen in history. We’ll see what happens….

raw_summary: Your car insurance renewal amount can be higher than last year for several reasons. Changes in coverage, additional benefits, a lower no-claim bonus or GST can affect the final bill. This often leaves car owners wondering, Why is my car insurance premium so high? The answer usually becomes clearer when you check the individual charges instead of looking only at the total. Reviewing the premium breakdown and tax invoice can help you identify extra charges, understand the GST amount and spot any billing errors before making a payment.

article_paragraphs: Your car insurance renewal amount can be higher than last year for several reasons. Changes in coverage, additional benefits, a lower no-claim bonus or GST can affect the final bill. This often leaves car owners wondering, Why is my car insurance premium so high?

The answer usually becomes clearer when you check the individual charges instead of looking only at the total. Reviewing the premium breakdown and tax invoice can help you identify extra charges, understand the GST amount and spot any billing errors before making a payment.

The total premium includes different charges, depending on the coverage selected. Understanding these components helps you compare car insurance options and see where your money goes. Depending on the policy, it can include:
Third-party cover: This pays for covered liability towards other people or their property. Its base premium follows prescribed rates for the vehicle category.
Own-damage cover: This protects your car against insured events such as accidents, theft and fire. The amount depends on the vehicle and the cover selected.
Optional add-ons: Covers such as zero depreciation or engine protection increase the premium when selected.
A quote shows the proposed amount before purchase. The tax invoice records the amount charged after the policy is issued. Keep both documents.
A higher bill does not always mean the tax has increased. Check what changed since your previous policy.

raw_title: NRDC Assessment of BAAJA, the 2026 Permitting & Transmission Bill
title: NRDC Assessment of BAAJA, the 2026 Permitting & Transmission Bill
raw_summary: The Bipartisan American Affordability and Jobs Act of 2026 (BAAJA) is the result of years of negotiations on permitting reform. The product is a bill that combines critically important transmission and grid reforms with significant and concerning changes to federal environmental laws, permitting standards, and judicial remedies. The transmission provisions in the bill would produce substantial and durable benefits, updating an aging power grid by allowing new investments. These reforms, which NRDC has long supported, are an essential component of accelerating the electrification and decarbonization of the power sector and achieving greenhouse gas reduction targets. On their own, these changes are much needed and overdue; they would also help any future clean energy incentives and standards succeed in cutting emissions. But transmission is an enabling technology rather than a substitute for policies that directly drive clean energy investment and reduce pollution.
summary: The Bipartisan American Affordability and Jobs Act of 2026 (BAAJA) is the result of years of negotiations on permitting reform. The product is a bill that combines critically important transmission and grid reforms with significant and concerning changes to federal environmental laws, permitting standards, and judicial remedies.
article_paragraphs: The Bipartisan American Affordability and Jobs Act of 2026 (BAAJA) is the result of years of negotiations on permitting reform. The product is a bill that combines critically important transmission and grid reforms with significant and concerning changes to federal environmental laws, permitting standards, and judicial remedies.

The transmission provisions in the bill would produce substantial and durable benefits, updating an aging power grid by allowing new investments. These reforms, which NRDC has long supported, are an essential component of accelerating the electrification and decarbonization of the power sector and achieving greenhouse gas reduction targets. On their own, these changes are much needed and overdue; they would also help any future clean energy incentives and standards succeed in cutting emissions. But transmission is an enabling technology rather than a substitute for policies that directly drive clean energy investment and reduce pollution.

However, there are a number of concerning provisions that raise substantial issues and reinforce the position of incumbent energy interests. The “project certainty” language is designed to ensure projects cannot be arbitrarily canceled. As drafted, it could benefit fossil fuel, mining, data center, and other industrial projects more than clean energy. It could also limit agencies’ ability to address newly discovered harms, constrain future pollution regulation, and create large taxpayer-funded corporate handouts.

The bill would also weaken key elements of core environmental laws, including the Clean Water Act (CWA), the Endangered Species Act, the National Environmental Policy Act (NEPA), and the National Historic Preservation Act (NHPA). The bill would narrow environmental review across those statutes, diminish state and Tribal authority, constrain public participation, and restrict courts’ ability to stop projects proceeding under unlawful permits. These changes erode fundamental protections for communities.

The backdrop, of course, is the Trump administration’s nonstop attacks on clean energy projects, tax incentives for clean energy, and climate standards. NRDC’s analysis finds in aggregate that the Trump administration’s actions could double carbon emissions from the power sector over the next decade while raising consumers’ electric utility bills by $30 billion per year by 2035. Lawmakers should push for tangible evidence that this has changed before voting on the legislation.

While NRDC is encouraged by the transmission provisions, other elements of the bill are deeply flawed. We will be seeking improvements in the coming weeks and will take a position on the bill before a floor vote.
Below is an assessment of the most positive and most negative elements of the bill. This is not intended to be comprehensive.

An aging power grid desperately needs updating, and with more extreme weather and surging demand from data centers, getting new electricity connected to the grid quickly is essential to keeping energy costs down and maintaining resilience. In one fell swoop, this legislation would address these issues, producing the necessary conditions to deploy more clean energy.

raw_title: Toyota Innova Hycross & Hyryder Hybrids Set New Records For Elevation Gains
title: Toyota Innova Hycross & Hyryder Hybrids Set New Records For Elevation Gains
raw_summary: GaadiWaadi - Innova Hycross completed a high altitude drive in under a day while the Urban Cruiser Hyryder achieved a separate record on one tank of petrol Toyota Kirloskar Motor has secured two Asia Book of Records titles after the Innova Hycross and Urban Cruiser Hyryder completed a journey from West Bengal to Sikkim. The Innova Hycross attained an altitude of 4,310 metres in 22 hours 52 minutes meeting the 24-hour requirement for its record category. The Urban Cruiser Hyryder arrived at the same destination on a single tank of petrol. The two vehicles use different petrol-electric hybrid systems. The Innova Hycross has a 2.0-litre four-cylinder petrol engine coupled with Toyota’s fifth generation hybrid technology producing a combined power output of 183.7 hp. The Urban Cruiser Hyryder uses a smaller 1.5-litre petrol engine and an electric motor generating around 114 hp. Both vehicles employ an electronically controlled automatic transmission but their engine capacities and electrical components differ. The Innova Hycross received recognition for the maximum elevation gained by a car within 24 hours. The Hyryder secured a separate title for the highest elevation gained on one tank of fuel. The latter achievement concerns the ability to complete the specified ascent without refuelling – not a measured fuel-economy record. Both results were recognised by the Asia Book of Records following the respective driving challenges. The journey began at Mandarmani in West Bengal, just two metres above sea level before ending at Nathula Pass in Sikkim at 4,310 metres. The vehicles encountered coastal roads, national highways and mountainous sections on their way to the Himalayan destination. The considerable altitude difference also meant changes in road gradients, temperatures and atmospheric conditions. The two record categories placed separate requirements on the vehicles despite their common destination. The Innova Hycross Hybrid has an ARAI-certified fuel economy figure of 23.24 kmpl and a 52-litre petrol tank. The Urban Cruiser Hyryder Hybrid returns a certified 27.97 kmpl and carries a 45-litre fuel tank. The Hyryder has the advantage in certified fuel efficiency but those laboratory figures do not establish the consumption recorded on the mountain journey. However, the actual distance travelled and petrol used on the record attempt have not been specified. The petrol-electric systems can operate using the combustion engine, electric motor or a combination of both based on driving conditions. Regenerative braking recovers energy when the vehicle slows down and the petrol engine can also recharge the hybrid battery. Neither vehicle requires an external charging connection. The electric motors assist the petrol engines when required and the automatic hybrid systems manage the power sources without manual intervention from the driver.

F 450 GS Sport is essentially the GS Trophy, without the Easy Ride Clutch (ERC), which is available exclusively with the GS Trophy variant. Among enthusiasts planning to buy the BMW F 450 GS, the priorities can be broadly classified into ‘with ERC’ and ‘without ERC’. For the latter group, the new Sport variant ensures that all other features are accessible including the adjustable suspension.

Sport variant’s Racing Red paintwork creates an exciting contrast and complements the bike’s sporty profile. Sharp design elements of the bike are better accentuated with this new colourway. The red shade is used largely across the front cowl, fuel tank and rear side panels. Rest of the surfaces are mostly black. The Sport variant also has distinctive graphics, combining themes in white and black.

This paintwork also does a good job at accommodating the gold-finished USD forks. Coming to equipment, the new Sport variant of BMW F 450 GS has sport suspension, Gear Shift Assistant Pro, offroad footrests, clear windshield and hand protection. The Sport variant also has Riding Modes Pro (+Enduro Pro). As is evident, the Sport variant has most of the features available with the top-spec GS Trophy variant.

Powering the F 450 GS is a 420cc twin-cylinder engine that produces 48 hp and 43 Nm of torque, paired with a 6-speed transmission. Ride modes include Rain, Road and Enduro. The bike uses a steel tube frame with the engine as a stressed member, along with a steel tube sub-frame. Suspension is 43 mm USD forks at the front and a monoshock at the rear. It rides on cast aluminium wheels, with disc brakes at both ends and ABS Pro.

Key features include ride-by-wire, an anti-hopping clutch, dynamic traction control (DTC) and dynamic engine brake control (MSR). The tech kit includes a 6.5-inch colour TFT instrument display, and there are heated grips, a Type C USB port and Bluetooth connectivity. You also get one key for all the locks, an adjustable foot brake lever, an on-board computer, and adjustable clutch and handbrake levers.

title: Crate Engine: A 508 BHP Chevrolet 383 Stroker V8
raw_summary: This is a 383 stroker V8 crate engine from the team at The Hot Rod Company, it’s rated at 508 bhp and it was developed for street-driven muscle cars, hot rods, trucks, and other automotive applications that favor plenty of torque low in the rev-range. article_paragraphs: This is a 383 stroker V8 crate engine from the team at The Hot Rod Company, it’s rated at 508 bhp and it was developed for street-driven muscle cars, hot rods, trucks, and other automotive applications that favor plenty of torque low in the rev-range.

This is the Chevrolet 383 Stroker V8 crate engine built by Hot Rod Company of Greenacres, Washington. It turns out 508 bhp and it was developed for street-driven muscle cars, hot rods, and modified trucks, with a focus on excellent low-end torque and usable performance, rather than high-rpm bragging rights.

The Hot Rod Company is a high-performance crate engine builder based out of Spokane Valley, Washington. It specializes in small-block and LS-based Chevrolet V8s, and it was co-founded by JR and Katie Roby.

The Robys say they started the business in 2006, while budgeting for their wedding and trying to stay out of debt. JR listed an engine from one of his race cars on Craigslist for $5,000, and it sold within a day. “And the phone kept ringing and ringing,” he later recalled in a 2023 interview.

He told Katie that if the calls continued he would say the engine was for sale and build another , and within the hour he said yes to the next caller. People kept calling about the original listing for days after, and it became very clear that there was an untapped market for good quality crate engines.

JR grew up in Salem, Oregon, where his after-school chores included stripping and building engines and transmissions with his father. He started drag racing at 16, and later while working as a personal trainer, he was sponsored by 24 Hour Fitness, which gave him a drag car and $30,000 a year to compete. He moved to Spokane in 2002 to help open one of the chain’s gyms.

The company has a policy that each engine is built by a single person, and that person signs the block when it’s done. A build takes about two days on average, but it can take longer for more complex builds. JR notes that the company has had warranty issues on fewer than 1% of their builds, a figure he credits partly to the one-builder approach.

Production version of the Vision S concept will be the first SUV based on Mahindra’s NU_IQ platform. This versatile platform is future-ready, with support for petrol, diesel, hybrid and fully electric powertrains. Test mules of Vision S have been frequently spotted and launch is expected by Q1, 2027. This will be a sub-4-meter SUV, likely positioned above the XUV 3XO in the company’s lineup.

Mahindra recently filed a design patent for the Vision S SUV. Key features include boxy proportions, an upright front fascia, distinctive lighting signatures, squared wheel arches, flush door handles, muscular body panelling and a tailgate-mounted spare wheel. Higher trims will get premium features like a panoramic sunroof, ventilated seats, wireless charging, Level-2 ADAS and a 360° camera setup.

Mahindra’s born-electric INGLO platform currently has three EVs – BE 6, XEV 9e and XEV 9S. This range will be expanded with BE 07, which is expected to be launched by Q1, 2027. Test mules have revealed exciting features such as frameless doors and pop-out flush door handles. BE 07 has a sharp, angular silhouette, ensuring a striking presence.

Key features expected with BE 07 include a digital IRVM, a triple screen layout, ventilated seats, immersive ambient lighting, premium audio system and auto parking. Connectivity functions will be powered by Adrenox and the SUV will have Level-2+ ADAS. Battery pack options could include 59 kWh and 79 kWh units, borrowed from BE 6. Mahindra BE 07 will take on rivals like Harrier EV, BYD Atto 3 and Vinfast VF7.

Another potential bestseller in the making, Mahindra Scorpio Lifestyler can give tough competition to rivals like Toyota Hilux and Isuzu D-Max V-Cross. Scorpio Lifestyler is the production version of the Global Pik Up concept unveiled in 2023. In addition to the domestic market, the Lifestyler pickup will be sold in multiple global markets.

Users can expect robust performance with the Lifestyler, as it’s built on the same ladder frame chassis as the Scorpio N SUV. Powertrain options for the Lifestyler are also expected to be the same as the Scorpio N SUV. Scorpio Lifestyler will be competitively priced, with Mahindra already announcing that the pickup’s starting price will be below Rs 19.79 lakh (ex-sh).

To meet growing demand for its SUVs and EVs, Mahindra will be increasing production. Rajesh Jejurikar, Executive Director and CEO (Auto and Farm Sector) at Mahindra, said that the company is already operating above its full production capacity. Current production capacity (SUV + EV) is at 68,000 units per month, as of September 2026.

title: Amazon set to deploy more than 3,000 TATA electric delivery trucks
raw_summary: Amazon isn’t just electrifying its American delivery operations. The virtual big box stores that Bezos built understands the benefits of EVs as well as anyone, and they’re working hard to deploy electric vehicles everywhere they can . And now, that global push is extending to India. Indian automaker TATA Motors has announced a deal with Amazon to deploy 3,000 electric trucks across Amazon’s transportation network in India . When it goes live, it will be the largest electric truck deployment by in India and mark Amazon’s most significant move to extend its Indian fleet electrification beyond last-mile logistics.
summary: Amazon isn’t just electrifying its American delivery operations. The virtual big box stores that Bezos built understands the benefits of EVs as well as anyone, and they’re working hard to deploy electric vehicles everywhere they can . And now, that global push is extending to India.
article_paragraphs: Amazon isn’t just electrifying its American delivery operations. The virtual big box stores that Bezos built understands the benefits of EVs as well as anyone, and they’re working hard to deploy electric vehicles everywhere they can . And now, that global push is extending to India.

Indian automaker TATA Motors has announced a deal with Amazon to deploy 3,000 electric trucks across Amazon’s transportation network in India . When it goes live, it will be the largest electric truck deployment by in India and mark Amazon’s most significant move to extend its Indian fleet electrification beyond last-mile logistics.

“India is accelerating towards electric mobility and the realization of Viksit Bharat 2047,” says Shri H.D. Kumaraswamy, Hon’ble Union Minister for Heavy Industries and Steel, Government of India. “The collaboration between TATA Motors and Amazon shows what that looks like in practice: sustained demand from a nationwide logistics network met by electric trucks manufactured in India. Through PM E-DRIVE, the Government will continue to support this transition, and I look forward to more such efforts in powering green logistics.”

In addition to being a big deal for TATA, the 3,000 electric truck deal represents a serous bump to India’s deployed electric truck fleet, and are a major step towards the wide-scale electrification of freight transportation across the country – that’s not just good for Amazon’s fuel bills, it’s good for everyone and everything that breathes air, too.

“ Electrifying our logistics and transportation network is an important part of Amazon’s goal to achieve net-zero carbon emissions by 2040 ,” says Abhinav Singh, Vice President, Operations, Amazon, APAC, Middle East, Africa and Turkey. “We have made significant progress in India, with more than 15,000 electric vehicles operating across 500-plus cities . To enable this transition, we are also supporting the development of infrastructure and solutions that make EV adoption easier for our carrier partners and drivers. We are now setting a bold vision to scale electric trucking , addressing one of the toughest challenges in decarbonizing transportation. Our collaboration with TATA Motors marks an important step towards realizing this vision. By combining our strengths, we aim to accelerate the deployment of electric trucks across more routes, starting with intracity operations and expanding to India’s major freight corridors.”

The truck Amazon will be deploying in these record numbers is a version of the Tata Ultra E.7, a 7.5-tonne (~16,000 lb.) straight truck powered by a 240 kW (~320 hp) electric motor drawing power from a 96 kWh LFP battery pack. The truck’s makers claim a loaded range of up to 130 km (~80 miles) on a single charge, with DC fast-charging that’s capable enough to keep the trucks charged up between deliveries.
Amazon’s new TATA electric delivery trucks will support the transport of goods between warehouse facilities – which means traveling across cities and along India’s national freight corridors.

Over 25 people attended the event featuring a panel of Sierra Club, Food & Water Watch, and Hillsborough Affordable Energy Coalition representatives, as well as a member of Tampa’s City Council and the city’s Sustainability & Resilience Officer.

TECO has recently boasted rate decreases, however, monthly bills for residential or small business customers using 1,000 kWh per month are still over $10 higher than in December 2024. While families contend with higher bills, the CEO of TECO made $2.5 million last year. The CEO of Emera, TECO’s parent company, made $9.5 million.

“Transparency shouldn’t be optional when families are forced to choose between keeping the lights on and buying groceries,” said Walter Smith II, Sierra Club’s Tampa Bay Organizing Representative . “We invited our neighbors, TECO reps, and environmental justice experts into the same room because the community deserves answers about their energy burdens and the various impacts of fossil fuels on our environment and health. This town hall is a critical first step toward demanding a just, affordable, and clean energy future for everyone in Tampa Bay.”

“Tampa residents have been struggling under the weight of skyrocketing electricity bills, all while Tampa Electric walks away with record profits year after year and passes the costs of fuel, storm recovery, and even its brand new Midtown headquarters onto ratepayers,” said Isabella Moeller, Florida Organizer for Food & Water . “But our community has had enough. TECO is a for-profit company beholden to shareholders only, that’s why we’re making a wide call to our local elected officials to hold TECO and its regulators accountable to the people they serve. Tampa City Council has an opportunity to pass an affordable energy resolution that commits the city to opposing TECO’s unjust rate hikes and supporting clean, affordable energy solutions. We must build on this momentum and ensure that affordable energy is a priority for every elected official in Tampa.”

raw_title: Winners & losers from F1 2026 Brazilian GP Friday practice
title: Winners & losers from F1 2026 Brazilian GP Friday practice
raw_summary: A familiar name at the top of the timesheet, but not your run of the mill F1 Friday at the Brazilian Grand Prix, as one struggling frontrunner got back in the groove again while the usual kings of Friday practice produced their worst result of the season. Here are our winners and losers from the first day of F1 track action at Interlagos.
summary: A familiar name at the top of the timesheet, but not your run of the mill F1 Friday at the Brazilian Grand Prix, as one struggling frontrunner got back in the groove again while the usual kings of Friday practice produced their worst result of the season.
article_paragraphs: A familiar name at the top of the timesheet, but not your run of the mill F1 Friday at the Brazilian Grand Prix, as one struggling frontrunner got back in the groove again while the usual kings of Friday practice produced their worst result of the season.
Here are our winners and losers from the first day of F1 track action at Interlagos.

Charles Leclerc and Ferrari had been fastest in Friday practice at three of the past four races, going back to October’s Bahrain Grand Prix in Malaysia, and a 6-7 FP2 result in Brazil (with Leclerc behind Lewis Hamilton) was the first time all season Ferrari has finished Friday outside the top five on the timesheet. Leclerc called it a “very, very difficult Friday” and described the feeling inside the car as “strange” and “very poor”. “We were losing in the straights, but I think the car in the corners just felt probably one of the worst Friday feelings of the season," he added. “So I think there's a lot to be found in corners, more than in the straights, where we know we have a deficit. Normally we are very fast in corners and today was not the case.” Team boss Fred Vasseur joked this was a Friday when Ferrari “have 200 kilos” of fuel inside the cars in order to flip the script, such is their usually prodigious form in free practice, but in a serious moment then admitted Ferrari has “a lot of work to do on the balance”. “The drivers, they were not happy,” he confirmed, while also saying he was “not less optimistic than last week” when Leclerc topped Friday in Mexico. “We had a couple of times a deployment issue in the lap,” Vasseur added. “We have to fine-tune everything. “On his fastest lap, he [Leclerc] lost a couple of tenths in a straight line. I would say that it’s not a drama. It’s more for you [the media] to be focused on page one [of the timing screen], but we are not. “We know that we have a lot to do on the balance. The balance was not good. The tarmac is the opposite of one week ago. It’s creating a lot of work to do and a difference compared to last week.” - Ben Anderson

Fastest in FP1 and looking competitive on longer runs - McLaren's upgrade package for Brazil appears to be working well, with the usual caveat that Fridays don't always offer perfect insight into the order. Senior racing director Randy Singh said it's "very likely" the upgrades - led by a new front wing - will stay on the car, and Friday went "really well" for the team, while Lando Norris cautioned that the team still looks two-tenths off Kimi Antonelli's Mercedes but "pretty good" compared to the other teams.
Norris also felt gently encouraged that McLaren's new 2027-ethos front wing had begun to address the long-standing edginess of the car's balance.
"I would say maybe there’s a small change in the right direction, that it seems just a little bit more straightforward to drive," he said.

"I don’t think we can ever judge things over just one track. But so far, for today, things have seemed a little bit more straightforward." After missing FP1, Singh says Oscar Piastri was also "immediately on the pace" - something which hasn't always happened this year - but the usual rule from recent races applies: the team needs to optimise qualifying, where its knife-edge car has let its long-run pace down all too often. - Jack Benyon

Every now and then, a lesser-known Friday driver pops up high on the timesheets in an FP1 outing, which is exactly what Gabriele Mini did on his second appearance for Alpine by setting the seventh-fastest time to head the midfield pack.

raw_title: ‘Dangerous’ but also ‘brilliant’
title: Dangerous' but also 'brilliant
raw_summary: New Haas driver Rafa Camara received a reprimand on his Formula 1 debut for what was deemed “clearly dangerous” impeding of Charles Leclerc in Brazilian Grand Prix practice. Camara weaved and moved into the racing line as he prepared to start a push lap in FP2 at Interlagos just as Leclerc was coming by to complete a lap of his own.
summary: New Haas driver Rafa Camara received a reprimand on his Formula 1 debut for what was deemed “clearly dangerous” impeding of Charles Leclerc in Brazilian Grand Prix practice. Camara weaved and moved into the racing line as he prepared to start a push lap in FP2 at Interlagos just as Leclerc was coming by to complete a lap of his own.
article_paragraphs: New Haas driver Rafa Camara received a reprimand on his Formula 1 debut for what was deemed “clearly dangerous” impeding of Charles Leclerc in Brazilian Grand Prix practice.
Camara weaved and moved into the racing line as he prepared to start a push lap in FP2 at Interlagos just as Leclerc was coming by to complete a lap of his own.

Though he was warned several times that Leclerc was approaching, Camara ended up squeezing the Ferrari towards the run-off at high speed “with a significant amount of the car off the track”, said the stewards, who upgraded the typical practice penalty for impeding from a warning to a formal reprimand.
“The situation that was created was clearly dangerous and [Camara] should have taken more care to avoid impeding [Leclerc]."
Camara’s incident with Leclerc was a blot on an otherwise solid and steadily improving first day in the car.

He finished 0.86s slower than Ollie Bearman in FP1, and trimmed the gap to 0.57s in FP2, with the biggest part of his time lost in the middle sector - although he had been even closer on the initial hard-tyre push laps before switching to softs.
There was a recurring problem under braking into Turn 1, where Camara had huge run-ending lock-ups in both FP1 and FP2, although several drivers had trouble here.
And he was still trying to smoothen his throttle usage exiting Turns 2 and 12 by the end of Friday as well.
